svg.title: Change the next descriptor while retaining old evidence
svg.desc: Constructed sets and zero-based row maps • no scheduler implementation
svg.text: Change the next descriptor while retaining old evidence
Constructed sets and zero-based row maps • no scheduler implementation
Live is not the same as executing
Before: live A/B/C; C becomes terminal
After admission: live A/B/D; execute D
A/B retain progress while D prefills
A free row need not mean free storage
C reader remains after logical removal
Three live plus C Retiring need four slots
D uses fresh state, not C’s old storage
Bind results to the producing epoch
Epoch 40: rows A@7, B@3, C@9
Epoch 41: rows B@3, D@1
Old row 1 means B@3, never new D@1
Commit each exact operation once
Keep attempt, generation, mode, position
Duplicate old result adds no extra output
Unknown completion retains access claims
Row compaction is not request identity; live-set removal is not physical retirement.
A next iteration requires qualified completion, output ordering and fresh resource credits.
